title: Block storage decides the bill: audited public-cloud price capture and a deterministic 36-month TCO model
description:
Raw price bodies captured on 2026-08-13 from the IBM Cloud Global Catalog (br-sao) and the AWS Price List (sa-east-1), the code that captured them, and a deterministic 36-month total-cost-of-ownership model for a twelve-server migration under two sizing methods.

For this workload AWS is cheaper in both phases, and the gap is produced by a single line item: block storage, USD 110,507 apart over 36 months — more than the total gap between the providers. Every published number is asserted by a test, and the captured evidence recomputes to the stage hashes of the study's sealed provenance chain.
notes: Published with the operator's explicit authorization on 2026-08-15. Companion artefact to a case study: it carries the evidence and the computation; the text of the study is not part of it. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21955051.
